pages.text: $(li)Use glass shards placed over graveyard soil to damage undead mobs (e.g., Wither Skeletons) repeatedly; the shards cause bleeding and generate LP.
$(li)This method works with Sacrifice Runes and is highly efficient.
$(li)Do not rely on standard mob grinders alone—undead mobs must be damaged $(o)repeatedly$() by the shards to sustain bleeding and LP output.
